recognize_zh: 這顆嗜中性球的細胞質中散布多顆大小不一、不規則的深紫灰色巨大顆粒，體積遠大於一般的中性顆粒，背景細胞質則相對缺乏正常顆粒，這種巨大包涵顆粒是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的典型表現。
features: Mature neutrophil with bilobed/elongated segmented nucleus
Multiple giant, irregular, dark purple-grey cytoplasmic granules of varying size
Granules markedly larger than normal neutrophilic granules; background cytoplasm pale and relatively agranular
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil containing multiple giant, irregular, dark purple-grey cytoplasmic granules that are several times the size of normal neutrophilic granules, set in otherwise pale cytoplasm. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic, and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are characteristic of Chediak-Higashi abnormality (giant fused lysosomal granules due to LYST mutation); correlation with partial albinism, recurrent infections and the risk of an accelerated hemophagocytic phase is advised.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules in AML or MDS
ddx.vs: Giant granules arise from abnormal fusion in dysplastic or leukemic myeloid cells, in the setting of increased blasts and other dysplasia.
Consists of numerous fine, evenly distributed dark granules of uniform size rather than a few giant irregular granules.
Dense, uniformly sized purple granules are present in all leukocyte lineages and are associated with mucopolysaccharidoses.
Inclusions are pale blue, spindle-shaped peripheral cytoplasmic bodies, accompanied by giant platelets in MYH9 disorders.
